req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should delete a player and return HTTP 204. We need to test this functionality with positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness. The positive test will confirm successful deletion, the negative test will handle non-existent player deletion, and the boundary test will check the behavior at the edge of valid input.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify the player is deleted
response = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_player
preconditions: Player with squad number 999 does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/999')
assert response.status_code == 404

preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:

from main import app
